Fire-attack.label: Fire-attack
Fire-attack.text: Before my attack roll, add 2 Attack dice.

Fire-defense.label: Fire-defense
Fire-defense.text: Before my defense roll, add 2 Defense dice.

Fire-damage.label: Fire-damage
Fire-damage.text: Before my attack roll, add 2 damage if it hits.

Fire-cancel.label: Fire-cancel
Fire-cancel.text: During combat, cancel the opponent’s immediately preceding tactic, including Cancel.

Fire-counter.label: Fire-counter
Fire-counter.text: Before my defense roll: if the attack misses, I may counterattack the attacker.

Fire-moveHeal.label: Fire-moveHeal
Fire-moveHeal.text: On my turn, move one friendly unit up to {hex:4} OR heal it 1 HP and remove all its Poison.

Fire-assault.label: Fire-assault
Fire-assault.text: On my turn, each friendly Recruit may make one free attack.

h01.label: Bisti Grasshade
h01.text: I make a [Ranged Attack] 3({hex:3}) with Heavy Attack(2). I must target an enemy which has none of my allies adjacent to it.

h03.label: Voru Cinderveil
h03.text: I Pull an enemy within {hex:4} up to {hex:3}. For each hex pulled, I give my nearest ally 1 Enraged.

h04.label: Tavi Sailwhistle
h04.text: Each time a Recruit ends their movement adjacent to an enemy this turn, I draw a Tactic card.

h11.label: Hester Wellward
h11.text: I move up to {hex:3} in a straight line, then each adjacent ally gains 2 Fortified.

h13.label: Demea Lastbanner
h13.text: My adjacent allies have Heavy Attack(2).

h06.label: Niala Grassveil
h06.text: I move another ally within {hex:3} up to {hex:2}, then give one enemy adjacent to that ally 1 Dazed.

h10.label: Orro Stormanchor
h10.text: Push up to two adjacent enemies up to {hex:2} each, then give them each 1 Dazed.

h12.label: Perrin Lastdrop
h12.text: I gain 2 Enraged. While I have Enraged, other adjacent allies gain +1 Attack die.

h14.label: Ilex Marchstep
h14.text: I move another adjacent ally up to {hex:3}, then I move up to {hex:3}.

objective-0.label: Close the Net
objective-0.text: Attack an enemy adjacent to at least three of my allies. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.

objective-1.label: Break the Levy
objective-1.text: Attack two different enemy Recruits in one turn. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.

objective-2.label: Into the Teeth
objective-2.text: Attack an enemy with a hero adjacent to at least two enemies. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.

objective-3.label: Pin Them Down
objective-3.text: End my turn with three friendly Recruits adjacent to the same enemy. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.

objective-4.label: At Their Gates
objective-4.text: End my turn with at least two friendly units adjacent to the enemy spawn area. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.

objective-5.label: Claim the Starfall
objective-5.text: End my turn with all my heroes occupying printed X locations. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.
